Get in touch ↗
How do I book?+

Choose a package or individual rentals, then send an inquiry with your date, venue and favourites. We’ll review availability and send a quote. Your booking is secured with a 50% non-refundable deposit; the remaining balance is due one week before the event.

What’s included in delivery?+

Package delivery, setup, teardown and pickup are included within 30 km of our address. Travel outside the Niagara Region is charged at $125 per hour of travel time. Share your venue with us so we can confirm delivery costs in your quote.

Can I rent just one or two games?+

Yes. Individual games are available from $125, which is the minimum rental charge. For three or more games, explore our collections for package pricing.

Can I pick up the games myself?+

We handle delivery, setup and collection. Our games need particular care during transport and setup, so you can leave that part to us.

How long can we keep the games?+

Your start time is arranged around your event, and the standard rental ends at 9 p.m. Extensions after 9 p.m. cost an additional $100 per hour.

What happens if we need to cancel?+

Deposits are non-refundable. Cancellations within seven days of the event receive no refund. One reschedule is allowed for extreme weather, subject to date and game availability; this does not cover illness, event cancellation or personal circumstances.

What if a game is damaged or missing?+

A replacement charge applies to damaged or missing games. The amount varies by game.

Do you support community events?+

We’d love to hear about events that bring the community together. Share your event details through our inquiry form or email us directly.
